svg.title: Pass rate and outcome mix by tool budget
svg.desc: Does loading more tools break the model? Pass rate by budget: tokens-0 67%, tokens-25000 57%, tokens-50000 63%, tokens-100000 64%, tokens-200000 64%

g.text: Does loading more tools break the model, and into what? One column per budget, smallest first; the line is the pass
rate (a trap's honest fail counts as a pass).
